figurative_meaning_en: to mature or come of age
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বয়স বাড়ার সাথে সাথে পক্ষোদ্গম হয়েছে।
এই সময়ে ছেলেটির জীবনে পক্ষোদ্গমের পর্যায় এসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: With age, he has matured like a bird growing its wings.
This is the phase in the boy's life where he comes of age.
note: Derived from Sanskrit roots, commonly used in literary Bengali to denote personal growth.
